products.name: Nanogrid 5kW
products.description: Perfect for homes and small offices, our 5kW nanogrid provides reliable power for essential loads with smart grid integration.
products.longDescription: The Nanogrid 5kW is our entry-level hybrid power solution, designed specifically for residential applications. It combines solar and wind energy generation with intelligent storage management to provide consistent, reliable power while maximizing renewable energy utilization. The system's smart grid integration ensures seamless switching between renewable sources and grid power, while the mobile app provides real-time monitoring and control.

products.name: Nanogrid 10kW
products.description: Ideal for small businesses and retail establishments, delivering consistent power with advanced load management.
products.longDescription: The Nanogrid 10kW is our mid-range solution, perfect for commercial applications requiring reliable power with sophisticated management capabilities. This system features advanced load management, allowing businesses to optimize their power consumption based on real-time demand and energy availability. The enhanced storage capacity and hybrid generation ensure business continuity even during extended grid outages.

products.name: Nanogrid 20kW
products.description: Engineered for industrial applications, providing robust power solutions with real-time monitoring and control.
products.longDescription: The Nanogrid 20kW is our flagship industrial solution, designed for demanding applications requiring substantial power capacity and sophisticated management capabilities. This system integrates seamlessly with existing industrial infrastructure while providing comprehensive monitoring and control capabilities. The robust design and redundant systems ensure maximum uptime for critical operations.
